title: [Known Issue] Support for macOS 12
body:
Note: If you're on macOS 12 and Discord no longer launches, it is recommended to install this version of the Discord app. This version will continue to work without updating, but installing any newer version will prevent Discord from launching.

As of September 17, 2026, Discord will no longer be supported on macOS 12.

To continue receiving updates and support for your Discord client, you must upgrade to at least macOS 13. Check out our OS/system requirements for Discord here.

You can find more information about upgrading your macOS from the following page:

  • Upgrade macOS on Mac

Frequently Asked Questions

Q. Will the Discord client I currently have installed continue to work after September 17, 2026?

A. Basic functionality may continue to work, however, the functionality and stability is not guaranteed as the client will no longer receive updates.

Q. If I cannot upgrade my computer right now, can I use the browser version of Discord?

A. Yes, as long as your browser meets the minimum requirements found here, you can continue to use it.
